note: Service-level privacy and secret-handling cases. Cross-user, cross-course, cross-assessment and student-record isolation are enforced by Laravel authorization BEFORE any data reaches this service; those boundaries are tested in backend/tests/Feature/Safety/*. These cases verify the AI service never adds a leak of its own (secrets, internal hosts, headers, environment) and never echoes credentials.
